verdict.rationale: Elicit offers an API with managed keys for programmatic access. Its docs say you can search papers and generate automated research reports "from your own code, scripts, and workflows", and the API can run a full systematic review end to end. All API functionality is also exposed via a remote MCP server, so the product can be driven headlessly without the web UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, a CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
